threads.text: Tunde find flat for Calabar and landlord ask for two years rent upfront. For Cross River State, law limit advance rent for individual tenant to three months, while company fit pay up to twelve months. How many months rent your own landlord ask you to pay upfront?
threads.evening: Landlord for Cross River no fit demand pass three months rent in advance from individual tenant.

short.title: Pay three months advance rent. Not two years.
short.hook_sub: Advance rent limits in Cross River State
short.hook_say: Tunde found a nice apartment in Calabar, but the landlord asked for two whole years of rent upfront before handing over the keys.

tips.sub: Cross River caps advance rent strictly
tips.say: In Cross River State, the law limits how much advance rent a landlord can demand from an individual tenant.
An individual tenant cannot be forced to pay more than three months of rent in advance under Cross River law.
Only corporate tenants or companies can be asked to pay up to twelve months of advance rent in Cross River.
Never clear two years of rent upfront when the state law protects your wallet.
